name: Narumol Srisawat
bio:
Narumol's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. Growing up in Bangkok, she spent her weekends tinkering with her grandfather's old tuk-tuk, learning the intricacies of internal combustion engines before she even hit her teens. This practical experience led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where she excelled in materials science and manufacturing processes. After graduation, Narumol joined a local racing team, quickly establishing herself as a reliable and resourceful fabricator. Her ability to adapt designs on the fly and find creative solutions to complex problems earned her a reputation as a valuable asset. 

Now at Sprint Masters, Narumol brings a meticulous approach to her work, ensuring every component meets the highest standards of precision and durability. She thrives in the fast-paced environment of the racing world, always eager to learn new techniques and push the boundaries of what's possible. Her calm demeanor and ability to remain focused under pressure make her a calming influence in the workshop, and her colleagues often seek her advice on difficult fabrication challenges. Her blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern engineering knowledge makes her a distinctive asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Narumol is petite but strong, with a focused intensity in her dark eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn sketches and engineering notes.
Insists on listening to traditional Thai music while working, claiming it helps her concentrate.
Has an uncanny ability to diagnose mechanical problems just by listening to the engine.
